historical_reviews.deepseek: Recognizes permanent EEPROM risk but loses exact target/mode/read-before sequence.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Restores literal transaction and identity controls.
historical_reviews.related_cases: FRU flash/read rows cover other EEPROM structures and cannot substitute serial field programming.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Requires one target/value manifest and verified rollback feasibility before any write.

original_test_intent: Read the original target GPU serial, program the exact approved replacement serial into the intended EEPROM field, and prove persistent readback and identity consistency.
original_method: Verify signed AGT syntax and stable physical/I2C target, read and back up raw/original serial, validate approved serial format/uniqueness/ownership, execute one write, read back after required reset/power cycle, compare exact bytes/text and cross-check inventory/log health.
manual_activity: Manufacturing/GPU owner approves exact target and serial, confirms backup/rollback and uniqueness, supervises write and owns verdict.
required_inputs: Exact approved serial per target with format/uniqueness validation
Original raw EEPROM/serial backup and restore method
safety_requirements: Read/verify target and original data before write
Reject literal placeholder, empty, duplicate or malformed serial
Single target and one write only
Stable power and no automatic retry
Read back/persist/cross-check; stop/recover on any byte, identity or health mismatch
agent_execution_scope: Perform source read and capture backup
Execute one authorized write then readback/persistence checks
Report without inventing serial, target or verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic write/read is directionally correct but omits source target/modes and irreversible identity safeguards.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Using the verified literal AGT modes and stable target, pre-read/back up, write the exact approved serial once, then read back after the required persistence boundary.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: I2C tuple `4,100`, read mode `4,4`, write mode `3,4` and read-before/write/readback order are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a signed one-row write manifest with target identity, original bytes/hash, approved serial bytes/hash and exact commands, followed by persistent/cross-surface verification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Prevents placeholder, duplicate, truncated and wrong-target writes and makes recovery evidence explicit.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: FRU flash or transient displayed serial does not substitute for the dedicated serial field/persistence check.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Some serial fields include checksums or fixed encoding; vendor semantics must be confirmed before write.

project_override_considerations: Manufacturing authority defines serial allocation, encoding/checksum and whether original field is safely restorable.
expected_evidence: Inventory/audit/log health, recovery disposition and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master consistently defines serial pre-read/write/readback; the placeholder is an input slot, not a literal value.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Tool, target, serial allocation and recovery inputs can be supplied.

review_improvement: Makes the permanent serial write target-bound, non-placeholder, uniqueness-checked, backed up and persistence-verified.
independent_technical_reasoning: A readback from the same command path can appear correct even if the wrong physical EEPROM was selected or a cached value is shown. Stable BDF/slot/I2C association and cross-inventory verification are required. Exact byte length/encoding and uniqueness must be validated before the one irreversible write because truncation or duplicate identity can break fleet/service traceability.
